skill.name: Spec-Kit Claude Code Workflow
skill.description: Guide teams through specification-first development with Spec-Kit, Claude Code, and repository-specific workflow rules.
skill.summary: Turns Spec-Kit requirements into clear Claude Code implementation workflows.
skill.author: Claude

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to keep specifications, prompts, and generated code aligned. This skill provides a repeatable workflow for Spec-Kit planning and Claude Code implementation.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use specification-first development with Claude Code.
Defines repository and folder guidance patterns for CLAUDE.md files.
Outlines specification formatting, naming, and quality checks.
Guides prompt iteration and feedback loops for implementation work.
Connects generated code review to specification success criteria.
limitations: Provides workflow guidance, not executable automation.
Requires existing requirements or specifications to be useful.
Does not validate code or specifications by itself.
Needs adaptation for each repository and team process.

use_cases.title: Standardize Spec-Kit Rollout
use_cases.description: Create a consistent specification-first process across a multi-folder repository.

use_cases.title: Prepare Claude Code Tasks
use_cases.description: Turn feature requirements into focused prompts, constraints, and review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Improve Requirement Traceability
use_cases.description: Map specifications to implementation steps and acceptance criteria before coding starts.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Spec-Kit Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a specification-first workflow for my project. Ask for missing repository, requirement, and team details before proposing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Repository Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my repository structure and suggest root and folder-level CLAUDE.md guidance that keeps implementation aligned with specifications.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Implementation Prompts
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these feature requirements and draft Claude Code prompts that include acceptance criteria, constraints, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Workflow Alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current implementation plan against the specification set. Identify gaps, unclear requirements, and prompt changes that reduce rework.

output_examples.input: A team is starting a multi-folder application with early Spec-Kit requirements.
output: Recommended root guidance for shared conventions.
A review cycle that checks implementation against acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: A developer has a feature specification but needs better Claude Code prompts.
output: A focused implementation prompt with required context.
A list of constraints to include before generation.
A validation checklist for the generated changes.

output_examples.input: A product manager wants traceability between requirements and delivered work.
output: A mapping from specification sections to implementation tasks.
A handoff format for developers using Claude Code.

best_practices: Keep specifications short, testable, and tied to acceptance criteria.
Update prompts when implementation reveals missing constraints.
Review Claude Code output against specifications before merging work.
anti_patterns: Using the skill after implementation decisions are already fixed.
Treating generated code as specification evidence without review.
Creating folder guidance that conflicts with repository-wide rules.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It guides the workflow that prepares Claude Code or Codex for implementation tasks.

faq.question: Do I need Spec-Kit already installed?
faq.answer: The skill assumes you understand Spec-Kit concepts and have requirements ready to organize.

faq.question: Can it help with CLAUDE.md files?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes root and folder-level guidance patterns for multi-folder repositories.

faq.question: Is this useful for quick prototypes?
faq.answer: Usually no. The skill is best when specifications improve quality more than they slow delivery.

faq.question: Can teams use it together?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports shared workflow rules, prompt patterns, and specification review habits.

faq.question: Does it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare implementation work, but human review and testing remain required.
